test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following elect(s) the presiding officer of the Vidhan Sabha in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Members of Vidhan Sabha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The presiding officer of the Vidhan Sabha, known as the Speaker, is elected by the **members of the Vidhan Sabha** from among themselves.
 
• The election of the Speaker is conducted soon after the formation of the new Vidhan Sabha following general elections.
 
• The Speaker's election is governed by the rules of procedure and conduct of business in the Vidhan Sabha.
 
• The Speaker plays a critical role in maintaining order and decorum in the House and ensuring its smooth functioning.
 
• The Deputy Speaker of the Vidhan Sabha is also elected by the **members of the Vidhan Sabha** through a similar process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vidhan Sabha** is the legislative assembly in states and union territories of India with a unicameral legislature.
 
• The Vidhan Sabha is composed of members elected directly by the people of the state through general elections.
 
• **Speaker of Vidhan Sabha:** The Speaker is responsible for presiding over the sessions of the Vidhan Sabha and ensuring adherence to parliamentary norms and procedures.
 
• **Governor's Role:** The Governor of the state summons and prorogues the Vidhan Sabha sessions and can dissolve it on the advice of the Chief Minister.
 
• **Vidhan Parishad:** In states with bicameral legislatures, the Vidhan Parishad serves as the upper house, but it does not participate in electing the Speaker of the Vidhan Sabha.
